description_en: Dissociates applications from a specified image version in batches
description_zh: 批量解除应用与指定镜像版本的绑定关系
name: UnbindApp

parameters.help_en: The list of application IDs to dissociate from the specified image version. Verify that each application is associated with the selected image version beforehand
parameters.help_zh: 需要从指定镜像版本解绑的应用 ID 列表。请先确认各应用与所选镜像版本存在关联
parameters.name: app_id_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image from which the applications are to be dissociated. The image must be a custom image or community image manageable by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除应用绑定的镜像 ID，须属于当前账号可管理的自定义镜像或社区镜像
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image version from which the applications are to be dissociated. If omitted, the current active version of the image is used. If specified, the version must belong to the image specified by ImageId
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除绑定的镜像版本 ID。省略时使用镜像当前生效版本；指定时必须属于 ImageId 对应的镜像
parameters.name: version_id

schema.description_en: The response of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This field is returned when the request fails and may not be included in a successful response
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This field describes the cause of a failed request and may not be included in a successful response
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
